lines.text: Never go Black Friday shopping at 3 AM.
lines.say: Never go Black Friday shopping at three A.M.

lines.text: The ad said: everything free for the first customer.
I was first. Nobody else showed up.
At 3:00, the doors slid open. By themselves.
lines.say: At three o'clock, the doors slid open. By themselves.

lines.text: Every shelf was full. Every price said zero.
A voice said: shoppers, please stay still.
Every mannequin turned its head. At me.
I ran back to the doors. Locked.
Then I saw the window display.
The new mannequin had my face. And my hoodie.
Its tag said: last one. Final sale.
So never go Black Friday shopping at 3 AM.
lines.say: So never go Black Friday shopping at three A.M.
